meta.title: Line items are the template's sheet rows
warnings: inserted configure_single_stage{eventType:rfq} — the single-stage screen opens as RFP, whose templates have no price sheet

plan.title: UI-SS-007 — Line items are the template's sheet rows

steps.note: Open single-stage create screen as specified in the setup.
Give the event a unique title.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Pick the Buy template for the single stage.
Add one line item via the manager.
Assert the badge shows one line item.
Fill the pricing sheet cells for the row.
Set the schedule so the event can be published.
Invite a vendor to the event.
